findings.proposed: official GSO store page for the standard
findings.evidence: Source is the MV technical-regulations schedule PDF (an index of many standards), not the instrument itself; GSO store pages exist per standard.

Government site not fetchable; body is a template with no instrument text, so scope of 'ECAS/MOIAT' coverage of vehicles could not be checked. Summary claim of 'whole-vehicle approval dossiers' etc. is template-derived.

notes: Systemic: all 32 bodies are ~2 KB generic templates with no regulation text, and all GSO records share one schedule-PDF source_url (not the individual standard). Bodies' 'Related Regulations' and 'Primary Systems' lines are template text, so AI tags/summaries derived from them overreach (fuel tags on EV records, lamps in headlamp record, ISOFIX in CRS record). Several GSO titles lack official 'Methods of Test for Impact Strength - Part 3B/3C' wording. Precheck flags were not listed for these items. Status 'in-force' is used uniformly, including for a draft.
